dse_runs.notes: DDS/NCO spec: one sample per clock at >=250 MSPS, max_abs_err <= 2^-13, minimize LUTs. Favor pipelined families (one sample/clock); iterative families likely fail throughput. Keep data widths modest to hit the 13-bit accuracy floor without oversizing.

selected_facts.dds_provenance: simulated (hw_dse.l2.dds l2-v1: golden-model DDS, 32-bit phase accumulator, coherent 16384-point FFT, tone bin 1297)

final_text: Campaign complete — the single spec **dds_250msps** was taken down the full ladder and finalized. L1: the structured DSE graph spent all 400 evaluations (converged, with refine → add_family decisions) and produced a 29-design feasible Pareto front of pipelined CORDIC designs, all at 264 MSPS with error below the 2^-13 constraint. L2: SimPy system simulation of the top designs confirmed the selection (DDS SFDR 98.2 dBc, SNR 87.5 dB, 17-cycle latency, one sample/clock) with no selection change. L3–L5: the ladder sub-agent ran verify_rtl, synthesize and back_annotate — all returned no recorded measured data for this design (L4 is never run live; a fresh W=18 exhaustive L3 run is too heavy), so no winner change was flagged and no reexplore was needed. Final selection: `pipelined:data_width=18, n_iter=15, angle_guard=2, frac_guard=0, rounding=round` — 920 LUTs (estimate, M1 calibration), 953 FFs, 264 MSPS, max_abs_err 2^-13.17 (exact golden model), accuracy_bits 13.2.
